notes.title: Strategy Fest %50 Discount!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce [i]Izmir: An Independence Simulator[/i] is taking part in Steam Strategy Fest and will be [b]%50 discounted[/b] during the festival.

Don't miss out on this perfect opportunity to dive into the post WW1 fictional world of [i]Izmir: An Independence Simulator[/i]!

Steam Strategy Fest runs August 28 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) to September 4 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7).

notes.title: Izmir An Independence Simulator is part of Spring Sale with 🔥%50 Discount!🔥
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! 🙌 
We are happy to announce that our game Izmir An Independence Simulator is part of Spring Sale with 🔥%50 Discount!🔥🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833380/Izmir_An_Independence_Simulator/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

3 different enemy classes: Infantry, Armored and Robotic. Beat the toughest levels with the right combinations and bonus damage. Every character in the game thinks differently and your relationship with them changes with every choice you make. Make jokes about them. Spread the gossip.

notes.title: Izmir: An Independence Simulator is released in early access on Steam! 🥳
notes.notes:
Fellow Soldiers!⚔️

The time has finally come! 🥳

You are expected to join the ranks on Steam Early Access and fight for the beloved city of Izmir's indepedence. 🎉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833380/Izmir_An_Independence_Simulator/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

Lead the people of Izmir in this tower defense strategy game with RPG elements combined. 🏰

Use future tech while keeping everything balanced and under control otherwise everybody could go nuts!😨

❗️ Don't forget to give us feedback about "[b]Izmir: An Independence Simulator[/b]" on our Discord server!
❗️ Next in Game Official Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/TGzUUpyKNS]Join our Discord![/url]

That’s enough for today’s blog, we would like to see all of you on our page. 
We can’t wait to bring the full version. 🚀

Hope that you can try our game and give us your feedback! 🤓
